newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 600 MW Homer City coal-fired unit restarts.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 600 MW Homer City coal-fired unit restarts.

text.p: Restart of the 600 megawatt (MW) unit at the coal-fired Homer City, Pa., generating facility began Monday afternoon after a restart attempt stalled this weekend, the operator said.
"It restarted at 3:19 (1519 EST/2019 GMT). There was a startup problem over the weekend," a GPU Generation Inc spokeswoman said.
Homer City's unit 2, which was shut Monday to repair an oil feed pump, was scheduled to resume service this past weekend.
Pennsylvania Electric Co (Penelec) and New York Electric & Gas Corp, each have 50 percent stake in Homer City 2.
Both Penelec and GPU Generation are subsidiaries of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
